claims: Exact F-compatible splitting transport preserves original rho=Q+2ell-lambda and same finite Omega.
Same rational CM point c1 calibrates all F-balanced A heights modulo the actual polarization line Qp*kappa.
Exterior minors eliminate every unknown A height matrix and the remaining common scalar.
Every target minor is nonzero on every local disc by BMS Theorem 7.9 applied to actual corrected NS-kernel line bundles.
Actual primitive factor has g>=3, so the exterior space has dimension at least two.
Exact c1 coefficients through degree two and exact first order of the vector V, with no p-unit claim.
boundaries: R616 nonvanishing not proved for all p.
Fixed Y-linear height ell and actual finite target values remain to be computed.
No p-unit, regulator valuation, complete disc exclusion, or transport to a different twist is asserted.

publication.index_summary: 在R616真实本原非消失区域，以同一有理CM点c1校准F相容高度并取外积，消去全部A高度矩阵；实际NS核局部高度的BMS代数独立性给逐目标逐盘非恒零，保留固定Y线性项/有限目标及首项赋值缺口。
publication.handoff_summary: R634已给不含A高度矩阵的有限真实高度方程；g>=3、原rho符号和同一Omega已固定，c1前两阶显式；仍需ell/Omega/真实系数与尾界，非统一排除。

calculation: Pure proof; no new long local computation.
